Original Arkline calibration meshes, under the repository license.

Both are closed four-triangle tetrahedra with scalar materials. Wedge is green, translated to (10,2,-3), with measured body bounds (10,2,-3)..(14,4,-2) m. Spire is magenta, translated to (-7,1,4) and rotated +90 degrees around Y, with bounds (-7,1,3)..(-4,7,4) m. These are calibration assets, not rated equipment.
